description.value: At 20th level, the chemist makes a grand discovery. He immediately learns two normal discoveries, but also learns a third discovery chosen from the linked list, representing a truly astounding alchemical breakthrough of significant import: Awakened Intellect (Intelligence score permanently increases by 2 points), Eternal Youth (no penalty to physical ability scores from advanced age), Fast Healing (gains fast healing 5), or Poison Touch (gains a poisonous touch, as if under the effects of a poisoned touch spell).
